occurrences.text: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the Lord be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
